program-invoke.friendlyAccountPrivilege: Account privileges do not match. An account needs signer/writable privileges that were not provided; check the IDL accounts and signer wallets.
program-invoke.friendlyInvalidAccountData: Account data does not match the expected type or could not be deserialized. Confirm the account address, network, and Program ID.
program-invoke.friendlyAccountAlreadyInUse: The account to create already exists. Use a unique ID, or confirm the operation has not already run.
program-invoke.friendlyComputeBudgetExceeded: The transaction exceeded compute limits. Try increasing the Compute Budget or splitting/optimizing the instruction.
program-invoke.friendlyCustomProgramError: The program returned custom error {code}, but no Anchor error message was found in the logs. Check the raw logs below or confirm the IDL includes error definitions.

program-upgrade.title: Direct Program Upgrade
program-upgrade.hint: The Upgrade Authority must be the signing wallet. This writes a buffer and runs the upgradeable-loader upgrade directly, without Squads.
program-upgrade.upgradeStarted: Upgrade started: checking and extending ProgramData if needed, creating the buffer, writing about {writes} chunk transactions ({bytes} bytes), submitting the upgrade, and verifying on-chain data. Large programs can take a few minutes; if a transaction fails to confirm in time you will see an error instead of an endless spinner.
program-upgrade.progressStepBuffer: Check capacity and create the upgrade buffer
program-upgrade.progressStepVerify: Read back and verify on-chain program data
program-upgrade.progressWaitHint: The password panel is closed while the upgrade continues. Write progress updates below; success or an error appears when finished. Keep this page open and make sure the RPC is reachable.
program-upgrade.passwordInvalid: Wallet password is incorrect; cannot unlock the Upgrade Authority wallet
program-upgrade.passwordWalletMismatch: Password unlocked wallet {wallet}, but the expected Upgrade Authority is {authority}
program-upgrade.walletPasswordTooltip: Enter the local keystore password for the Upgrade Authority wallet. It is used only for this decrypt/sign step and is not saved.
program-upgrade.fillAllFields: Select the Upgrade Authority wallet, enter the Program ID, and choose a .so file
program-upgrade.compileRequiredHint: Build and import the latest artifact first, or manually choose a new .so file.
program-upgrade.staleArtifactTitle: Current .so matches the last deployed artifact
program-upgrade.staleArtifactHint: Current SHA-256 {current} matches the latest successful deploy/upgrade record {previous}. This is likely an old build. Rebuild and import before upgrading.
program-upgrade.staleArtifactBlocked: The current .so has the same hash as the last successful deploy/upgrade. Rebuild and import a new .so before upgrading.
program-upgrade.stats: write transactions: {writes}, program size: {bytes} bytes, ProgramData capacity: {capacity} bytes, rent: {rent} lamports (extension {extensionRent})
program-upgrade.friendlyInsufficientBalance: Insufficient balance: about {currentSol} SOL now, need about {neededSol} SOL (short about {shortfallSol} SOL). Fund the Upgrade Authority wallet and retry.
program-upgrade.friendlyInsufficientFunds: Insufficient balance to create the upgrade buffer or pay fees. Fund the Upgrade Authority wallet and retry.
program-upgrade.friendlyAuthorityMismatch: Upgrade Authority does not match the signing wallet, or on-chain authority is different.
program-upgrade.friendlyProgramDataTooSmall: The new .so exceeds current ProgramData capacity and automatic expansion did not complete. Check the raw error and extension transaction before retrying.
program-upgrade.friendlyGenesisMismatch: Genesis hash does not match the expected network. Confirm the selected network.
program-upgrade.friendlyTimeout: An upgrade transaction was submitted but did not confirm before the timeout. Check that your RPC is healthy and the wallet has enough SOL, inspect that signature on an explorer, then retry carefully (do not spam retries).
program-upgrade.friendlyBusy: Another deploy/upgrade is already running. Try again shortly.
